prompt.source: Workshop update: Mara Chen suggested moving the ceramics display on Tuesday. The curatorial team may move it only after Noah Patel completes the lighting check. The check is unfinished and no relocation has been approved. Visitor badges have already arrived.
prompt.instruction: Summarize in one shorter English sentence. Preserve Mara Chen as proposer, Tuesday as the proposed relocation date, the curatorial team as the acting team, Noah Patel completing the lighting check as a prerequisite, and both the unfinished check and unapproved relocation. Omit visitor badges.
